'''Setagana''' was [[Warder]] to [[Anaiya]] Sedai.

==Appearance==
He was lean and dark, and considered beautiful for a man. {{ref/book|10|16}}

==Activities==
He is one in the group of Warders that accompany Egwene and Anaiya when they survey the area around [[Tar Valon]]. {{ref/book|10|16}}

He was murdered, along with Anaiya, by [[Aran'gar]] with ''[[saidin]]''. Their bodies were found in the snow. 

Egwene wants [[Nisao Dachen]] to find out why Anaiya and he were out while everyone else was sleeping.
